paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.73% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (+3.13%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-8.01%). Brent crude changed +4.54% to 109.47. Gold changed -0.85% to 4,180.3999. Bitcoin changed -2.79% to 81,347.5078. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.121%, a relative move of -2.35%. Among the firms tracked, ConocoPhillips (+8.71%) and US Oil Fund (ETF) (+8.69%) moved the most.
